core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sidra (سِدْرَة) is an Arabic-origin female name meaning 'lote tree'; it is associated with Sidrat al-Muntaha, the lote tree mentioned in the Qur'an.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The Arabic noun سِدْرَة (sidrah), 'lote tree (a jujube tree)', used as a given name.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sidra is a botanical noun — the lote tree — and it is used as a name for the tree's association with the Qur'anic Sidrat al-Muntaha.

etymology.etymological_meaning: From the Arabic root س د ر (s-d-r), which denotes the lote/jujube tree.

arabic.name: سِدْرَة
